privacy.title: Privacy at WallGo
privacy.subtitle: A clear look at the information WallGo handles, how it supports the service, and the controls available to you.
privacy.summaryNote: This page explains WallGo's privacy practices in plain language. Review the sections below to understand what information is used and how to manage your account.

information.title: Information we collect
information.description: We handle information you provide and activity generated as you use WallGo, to operate the features you choose to use.

account.title: Account details
account.description: Your username and email address, along with the credentials needed to create and access your account.

profile.title: Profile information
profile.description: Details you add to your profile, such as your name, photo, bio, and other information you choose to share.

content.title: Your content
content.description: Posts, Reels, comments, and bookmarks or other saved items associated with your account.

interactions.title: Interactions and metrics
interactions.description: Activity such as follows, likes, comments, saved items, and content or profile views, which helps features work and provides engagement counts.

profileViews.title: Profile views & visitor privacy
profileViews.description: Profile view counts help people understand engagement without presenting a public list of who visited.

recording.title: How views are counted
recording.description: When you are signed in, WallGo may associate a profile view with your account and the profile viewed so repeat views can be counted once.

visibility.title: What profile owners see
visibility.description: The profile feature displays an aggregate visitor count, not a list of visitor identities. The view record is still processed by WallGo to operate this feature.

usage.title: How we use data
usage.description: Information supports the core features of WallGo and helps us keep the service useful and reliable.

feed.title: Personalize your experience
feed.description: Use your connections and activity to organize relevant posts, Reels, and community content in your experience.

security.title: Protect the platform
security.description: Support account authentication, help identify misuse, and maintain the safety and reliability of WallGo.

notifications.title: Deliver notifications
notifications.description: Provide service notifications and activity updates related to your account and interactions.

improvement.title: Improve WallGo
improvement.description: Understand how features are used so we can maintain, troubleshoot, and improve the product.

security.title: Data security & storage
security.description: We use technical and organizational safeguards intended to protect information, while recognizing that no online service can guarantee absolute security.

authentication.title: Authentication & access controls
authentication.description: WallGo uses Sanctum-backed authentication for protected API requests and access controls to help limit account actions to signed-in users.

storage.title: Protected systems
storage.description: Account information and activity are stored in application databases. We apply security practices to protect these systems and the information they handle.

control.title: Your control
control.description: Use account features and settings to manage the profile information and content associated with your account.

rights.title: Your rights & controls
rights.description: WallGo gives you tools to review and manage information you have added to your account.

profile.title: Update your profile
profile.description: Review and edit profile details through your account profile and editing options.

content.title: Manage your content
content.description: Delete posts and Reels you have shared using the controls available with your content.

settings.title: Manage account settings
settings.description: Adjust available account, notification, visibility, and security settings to suit your preferences.

about.description: A modern social space for authentic moments, creative expression, and meaningful connection.
about.whyDescription: Social media should make it easier to connect, share, and discover—not feel cluttered or invasive. WallGo was created in 2026 to bring the focus back to people, with an experience designed around creativity, community, and user choice.
about.featuresTitle: A place for every part of your story
about.featuresDescription: Share what matters, find your people, and keep the moments you want to come back to.

posts.title: Posts
posts.description: Share photos, thoughts, and everyday updates with your community.

reels.title: Reels
reels.description: Create and discover short-form videos that bring ideas and moments to life.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.description: Save posts and inspiration to revisit whenever you want.

communities.title: Pages & communities
communities.description: Build a space around your interests, bring people together, and grow as a community.

profileViews.title: Anonymous profile views
profileViews.description: See profile view insights while keeping the identity of visitors private.

timeline.beginningDescription: Development began with a vision for a complete, modern social network built around genuine connection.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: These terms explain the basic rules for using WallGo, sharing content, and taking part in the community.
terms.summaryNote: Please read these Terms before using WallGo. They are a plain-language overview of important conditions; if you do not agree, do not register for or use the service. Rights that cannot be limited under applicable law remain unaffected.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.description: WallGo launched in 2026. By creating an account or using the platform, you agree to these Terms and to follow the rules that help keep the service safe and useful.

agreement.title: Your agreement
agreement.description: If you do not agree to these Terms, do not create an account or continue using WallGo.

updates.title: Changes to these Terms
updates.description: We may update these Terms as WallGo evolves or as requirements change. The revised version will be posted here with an updated effective date. Continued use after an update takes effect means you accept the revised Terms.

accounts.eyebrow: Keep your account in good standing
accounts.title: User accounts & security
accounts.description: You are responsible for the information you provide and for taking reasonable care of your account.

accuracy.title: Accurate information
accuracy.description: Provide accurate account and profile information, and update it when it changes so your account details remain current.

credentials.title: Protect your credentials
credentials.description: Keep your password and sign-in credentials private. Do not let others use your account, and take reasonable steps to protect your devices and sessions.

responsibility.title: Account activity
responsibility.description: You are responsible for activity carried out through your account. If you believe someone has accessed it without permission, secure your account using the available password recovery options.

content.title: User-generated content
content.description: You decide what to share. You are responsible for the content you post, the rights you have to it, and how it affects others.

ownership.title: You keep ownership
ownership.description: You retain ownership of Posts, Reels, comments, and other content you create, subject to the rights of other people whose material you include.

permission.title: Permission to operate WallGo
permission.description: When you share content, you give WallGo a non-exclusive permission to host, store, reproduce, display, and distribute it as needed to provide, secure, and operate the features you choose to use.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks and saved content
bookmarks.description: Bookmarks are saved references to content, not a transfer of ownership. The original creator keeps their rights, and the content remains subject to its audience and visibility settings.

rules.title: Content that is not allowed
rules.description: Do not post or share harassment, threats, spam, illegal material, content that violates another person's rights or privacy, or anything else prohibited by applicable law.

features.title: Platform features & interactions
features.description: WallGo includes public feeds, messaging, and engagement features. Use them respectfully and consider the audience and visibility of each interaction.

feeds.title: Feeds and sharing
feeds.description: Content shared to public areas may be visible to other people. You are responsible for choosing what to publish and for respecting the rights and privacy of others.

messaging.title: Messaging
messaging.description: Use messages for legitimate communication. Do not use messaging to harass, threaten, spam, or otherwise harm other people.

profileViews.title: Profile view insights
profileViews.description: WallGo may record a signed-in profile view to prevent duplicate counts. Profile owners see an aggregate count, not a list of visitor identities; the underlying activity is still processed to provide the feature.

integrity.title: Respect platform integrity
integrity.description: Do not interfere with WallGo, bypass access controls, scrape data without permission, manipulate engagement metrics, or use automated means to disrupt the service.

termination.title: Termination & suspension
termination.description: We may take action when necessary to protect people, the service, or compliance with applicable law.

enforcement.title: When action may be taken
enforcement.description: WallGo may remove content, restrict features, suspend, or terminate an account that violates these Terms, community guidelines, or applicable law, or that puts the platform or its users at risk.

access.title: Effect on access
access.description: A suspension or termination may limit or end access to your account or content. Where appropriate and practical, we may provide notice or an opportunity to address the issue.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.description: This section describes limits on responsibility to the extent allowed by applicable law. It does not remove any rights or remedies that cannot legally be excluded.

availability.title: Service provided as available
availability.description: WallGo is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. We do not promise that the service will always be uninterrupted, error-free, secure, or available at every time or location.

limits.title: Limits where permitted by law
limits.description: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, WallGo is not responsible for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive losses arising from your use of, or inability to use, the service.

protection.title: Rights preserved
protection.description: Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability or consumer rights that cannot be excluded or limited under the laws that apply to you.

resetPassword.question: How do I reset my password?
resetPassword.answer: Go to the Log in page and choose “Forgot password?”. Enter the email address linked to your account, then follow the instructions sent to your inbox. Check your spam folder if the message does not arrive.

accountAccess.question: What should I do if I cannot access my account?
accountAccess.answer: First try the password reset flow using the email associated with your account. If you still cannot sign in, use the contact form below and include the email address on the account. Never send us your password.

profileViews.question: How do anonymous profile views work?
profileViews.answer: When you are signed in, WallGo may associate a profile view with your account to avoid counting the same viewer repeatedly. Profile owners see an aggregate visitor count, not a list of viewer identities; WallGo still processes the view record to provide this feature.

deleteContent.question: How can I delete a post or Reel?
deleteContent.answer: Open the post or Reel and use its options menu to choose the delete action. Confirm the prompt to remove the item. Only delete content you own or are authorized to manage.

privacySettings.question: Where can I manage my privacy and security settings?
privacySettings.answer: Open Settings from your account menu to review available account visibility, notification, and security options. You can also update profile details from your profile editing page.

reportProblem.question: How do I report a bug or send feedback?
reportProblem.answer: Choose General inquiries in the contact form, describe what happened, and include the steps to reproduce the issue if you can. Do not include your password or other sensitive credentials.

form.title: Send us a message
form.description: Choose a topic and tell us how we can help. Add a reply email if you would like us to get back to you.
form.categoryLabel: What do you need help with?
form.messagePlaceholder: Share the details that will help us understand your question...
form.mailtoNote: This opens your email app with a prepared message. Nothing is sent until you review and send it there.

contact.emailDescription: Prefer to write from your own email app? Reach the WallGo support team here.
contact.guidelinesDescription: Help keep WallGo welcoming by reviewing the rules for content and interactions.
contact.privacyNote: Only include information needed to resolve your request. Do not share passwords or private authentication codes.
